test.create_query: CREATE TABLE none_write ( a String CODEC(NONE), b String CODEC(NONE), c String CODEC(NONE), d String CODEC(NONE), e String CODEC(NONE), f String CODEC(NONE), g String CODEC(NONE), h String CODEC(NONE) ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() SETTINGS min_bytes_for_wide_part = 0, min_rows_for_wide_part = 0, parts_to_delay_insert = 5000, parts_to_throw_insert = 5000
test.query: INSERT INTO none_write WITH concat(toString(number), repeat('x', 64)) AS value SELECT value, value, value, value, value, value, value, value FROM numbers(3000000) SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_insert_threads = 1
